feature: Native Dodongo anatomy, motion and explosive-swallow integration
scope: Original ACTOR_EN_DODONGO with native rig, attack AI and collision rules; new custom species remain deferred.

art.space: Native joint-local XYZ, positions x100; native normals retained; authoring-pose transforms omitted

animation.rig: Original upper head, lower jaw, torso, three-part tail and two three-part legs; native draw-time torso/tail swelling retained

portable.asan_ubsan: passed; AppleClang address/undefined sanitizers on geometry, leak detection disabled

runtime.coverage: Original room population coexists with practice placement. All twelve meshes, cache identity, native scale/colliders, off gates and distance fallback. Live walk/footstep alternation, natural fire attack, head armor, body damage, tail sweep damage/blur, utility stun/recovery, ice effects and native death explosion. Bomb, bomb flower and Bombchu capture/consumption, native belly/tail swelling, one reward per death and scene teardown. Padded real-layout Bombchu regression detects the old out-of-bounds fuse write.
runtime.limits: Damage/armor checks inject native collider flags and damage records. Explosives are spawned at the mouth for deterministic native capture; this does not verify manual throws or every Bombchu approach angle. Geometry runs under ASAN/UBSAN; the full game runtime does not. The Deku Tree fixture is not a full dungeon, age, regional or crowded-performance acceptance test.

fixes: Use the actual explosive actor type for fuse access; only accept native bombs, bomb flowers and Bombchus. Captured Bombchus use the existing actor freeze timer until consumed.
Practice occupancy accounts for height, so distant overhead enemies do not block ground placement. Check the broad footprint and headroom before spawning.

visual.blender: Final studio and native fire, tail-sweep and walk poses inspected; all thirteen native animation clips remain in the editable source.
visual.native: Model inspected in the native Metal renderer with original skin texture detail, scene light/fog, separately moving jaw, grounded feet and segmented tail.
visual.production: Normal build summon succeeded with original room enemies present. Dodongo approached Link and fire caused visible damage/burning. Equipment journal pause was verified; the production test application subsequently exited with status 0.
visual.practice_path: More / Arsenal & enemy counters / Practice encounters / Upgraded Dodongos

build.scope: Isolated snapshot from the previously verified Bubble build. Added the dedicated Dodongo renderer and recompiled practice controls, native Dodongo and optional harness. Concurrent shared-worktree material/gear changes are not claimed as rebuilt. Shared Ninja builds and other users of the working tree were left alone.

blender.authoring: Installed Blender 5.1.2 in separate background factory-startup processes. Live MCP connection unavailable.

remaining: Other original enemy families, broader dungeon/age/terrain acceptance, original-material detail refinement and crowded-scene performance remain in the full active replayability goal.
